import os
import warnings
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

TRAIN_PATH = "./input/ru_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/ru_test_2.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = "./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv"

# Silence progress bars
lgb.set_log_level("silent")

print("Loading training data...")
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)

print("Loading test data...")
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Check if sample submission exists
sample_exists = False
if os.path.exists(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH):
    sample_exists = True
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)
else:
    # Create sample based on task description
    print("Sample submission file not found, creating template...")


def make_id(row):
    return f"{row['sentence_id']}_{row['token_id']}"


# Process training data
print("Processing training data...")
df_train["id"] = df_train.apply(make_id, axis=1)

# Process test data
df_test["id"] = df_test.apply(make_id, axis=1)

# Clean and extract relevant columns
train_features_to_compute = ["before_len", "first_char_ord", "sentence_id", "token_id"]
test_features_to_compute = ["before_len", "first_char_ord", "sentence_id", "token_id"]

X_train_raw = df_train.copy()
X_test_raw = df_test.copy()

# Compute features FIRST before selecting
X_train_raw["before_len"] = X_train_raw["before"].astype(str).str.len().fillna(10)
X_train_raw["first_char_ord"] = (
    X_train_raw["before"].astype(str).str[0].map(ord).fillna(-1)
)

X_test_raw["before_len"] = X_test_raw["before"].astype(str).str.len().fillna(10)
X_test_raw["first_char_ord"] = (
    X_test_raw["before"].astype(str).str[0].map(ord).fillna(-1)
)

# Remove redundant columns since we've computed the features
final_features = ["before_len", "first_char_ord", "sentence_id", "token_id"]

X_train_final = X_train_raw[final_features].copy()
X_test_final = X_test_raw[final_features].copy()

# Token-level label encoding for prediction
unique_after = sorted(dict.fromkeys(df_train["after"].unique()))
idx_to_label = {i: v for i, v in enumerate(unique_after)}
label_to_idx = {v: i for i, v in enumerate(unique_after)}

print(f"Number of unique token types in training: {len(unique_after)}")

y_train_array = np.array([label_to_idx[v] for v in df_train["after"]])

# Encode class column for additional feature (optional enhancement)
class_col = df_train["class"]
class_unique = list(class_col.unique())
class_encoder = lambda x: (
    [idx_to_label.get(v, 0) for v in class_col]
    if len(class_encoder(class_col)) == len(class_col)
    else np.zeros(len(class_col))
)
try:
    import sklearn.model_selection
    from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

    ce = LabelEncoder()
    X_train_final["class_encoded"] = ce.fit_transform(class_col)
except:
    # Fallback simple encoding
    class_encoder_map = {}
    ce.classes = class_col.value_counts().index[: max(1, len(class_col))]
    class_encoder_map = dict(zip(class_col, range(len(unique_after))))
    X_train_final["class_encoded"] = class_col.map(
        lambda x: class_encoder_map.get(x, -1)
    )

n_samples = len(X_train_final)

# PROPER HOLD-OUT SPLIT - NEVER RETRAIN ON THIS!
split_ratio = 0.8
split_idx = int(split_ratio * n_samples)
X_train_split = X_train_final.iloc[:split_idx].copy()
y_train_split = y_train_array[:split_idx]
X_val_split = X_train_final.iloc[split_idx:].copy()
y_val_split = y_train_array[split_idx:]

# Training dataset
train_dataset = lgb.Dataset(X_train_split.values, label=y_train_split)
val_dataset = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_split.values, label=y_val_split, reference=train_dataset
)

# Hyperparameters optimized for text normalization task
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "mse",
    "verbose": -1,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 3,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": 1,
}

print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_dataset,
    num_boost_round=2000,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
    valid_names=["train", "valid"],
    seed=42,
)

best_iter = model.best_iteration
print(f"Best iteration: {best_iter}")

# Get validation predictions on truly unseen data
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_split.values, num_iteration=best_iter)
val_preds_int = np.round(val_preds).astype(int).tolist()
true_vals = y_val_split.tolist()

# Compute token-level sequence accuracy (exact match)
correct_tokens = sum(
    1 for t, p in zip(true_vals, val_preds_int) if t == idx_to_label.get(p, -1)
)
accuracy_score = correct_tokens / len(true_vals)

print(f"Validation Accuracy (Token-Level): {accuracy_score:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test_final.values, num_iteration=best_iter)
test_preds_int = np.round(test_preds).astype(int).tolist()
final_predictions = [idx_to_label.get(p, "<unknown>") for p in test_preds_int]

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Create and save submission file
sub_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": df_test["id"], "after": final_predictions})
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)

print(f"Saved submission with {len(sub_df)} records to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
print(f"Final Validation Accuracy: {accuracy_score:.4f}")
